variants.text: face shape: oval; midface: rounded cheekbones, smooth infraorbital contours, shallow nasolabial folds; jawline: continuous, moderately defined; chin: rounded, shallow mentolabial sulcus; eyebrows: thin, soft-arched; eyes: almond-shaped, medium palpebral fissure, upward canthal tilt, double upper-lid creases; nose: straight dorsum, medium bridge width, rounded tip of moderate projection, narrow alar bases; mouth: medium width, balanced lip fullness, defined cupid's bow, level lip corners, smooth philtrum; hair: brown, strands partially obscuring forehead and left eye region.

Brown hair with strands partially obscuring the forehead and left eye region frames an oval face with a rounded chin and a continuous, moderately defined jawline. The features include thin, soft-arched eyebrows and almond-shaped eyes with a slight upward canthal tilt and double upper-lid creases. The nose has a straight dorsum and a rounded tip of moderate projection, while the medium-width mouth displays balanced lip fullness and a defined cupid's bow.
